import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 200;
    static final int MAXM = 100000;
    static final int INF = 199999999;

    static int[][] board = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] adj = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, N, limit;
    static String input;
    static int[][] human = new int[MAXN][3];
    static int[][] robot = new int[MAXN][3];
    static int zr, zc;
    static int hcnt, rcnt;
    static int[][] moves = {{0,-1},{0,1},{-1,0},{1,0}};

    static int valid(int r, int c) {
        if (r > 0 && r <= n && c > 0 && c <= n && board[r][c] != -1)
            return (r-1)*n + c;
        return -1;
    }

    static void makeGraph() {
        N = n * n;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(adj[i], -1);
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= n; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= n; ++c) {
                if (board[r][c] == -1) continue;
                int p = (r-1)*n + c;
                adj[p][p] = 0;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int nr = r + moves[d][0];
                    int nc = c + moves[d][1];
                    if (nr > 0 && nr <= n && nc > 0 && nc <= n && board[nr][nc] != -1) {
                        int np = (nr-1)*n + nc;
                        adj[p][np] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] q = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] inq = new int[MAXN];

    static void spfa() {
        int front = 0, rear = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) dist[i] = INF;
        int start = (zr-1)*n + zc;
        dist[start] = 0;
        q[0] = start;
        while (front < rear) {
            int u = q[front++];
            for (int v = 1; v <= N; ++v) {
                if (adj[u][v] == 1 && dist[v] > dist[u] + 1) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q[rear++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void floyd() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= N; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
                if (adj[i][k] == -1) continue;
                for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                    if (adj[k][j] == -1) continue;
                    if (adj[i][j] == -1 || adj[i][j] > adj[i][k] + adj[k][j])
                        adj[i][j] = adj[i][k] + adj[k][j];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int st, ed, flow, next;
        Edge(int st, int ed, int flow, int next) {
            this.st = st;
            this.ed = ed;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edge = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int E;
    static int src, dest;

    static void addEdge(int st, int ed, int flow) {
        edge[E] = new Edge(st, ed, flow, head[st]);
        head[st] = E++;
        edge[E] = new Edge(ed, st, 0, head[ed]);
        head[ed] = E++;
    }

    static void buildFlow() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        E = 0;
        src = 0;
        dest = hcnt + rcnt + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= hcnt; ++i)
            addEdge(src, i, human[i][2]);
        for (int i = 1; i <= rcnt; ++i)
            addEdge(hcnt + i, dest, robot[i][2]);
        for (int i = 1; i <= hcnt; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= rcnt; ++j) {
                int p1 = (human[i][0]-1)*n + human[i][1];
                int p2 = (robot[j][0]-1)*n + robot[j][1];
                if (adj[p1][p2] != -1 && adj[p1][p2] <= limit && adj[p1][p2] < dist[p2]) {
                    addEdge(i, hcnt + j, INF);
                } else if (adj[p1][p2] != -1 && adj[p1][p2] <= limit && adj[p1][p2] == dist[p2]) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int rr = robot[j][0] + moves[d][0];
                        int cc = robot[j][1] + moves[d][1];
                        int pp = valid(rr, cc);
                        if (pp != -1) {
                            if (adj[p1][pp] == adj[p1][p2] - 1 && adj[p1][pp] < dist[pp]) {
                                addEdge(i, hcnt + j, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] d = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean bfs() {
        int[] que = new int[MAXN];
        int front = 0, rear = 1;
        que[0] = src;
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        while (front < rear) {
            int u = que[front++];
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edge[i].next) {
                int v = edge[i].ed;
                if (d[v] == -1 && edge[i].flow > 0) {
                    d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                    if (v == dest) return true;
                    que[rear++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int[] stk = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cur = new int[MAXN];

    static int dinic() {
        int ret = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            int u = src, tail = 0;
            for (int i = src; i <= dest; ++i) cur[i] = head[i];
            while (cur[src] != -1) {
                if (u != dest && cur[u] != -1 && edge[cur[u]].flow > 0 && d[u] != -1 && d[u] + 1 == d[edge[cur[u]].ed]) {
                    stk[tail++] = cur[u];
                    u = edge[cur[u]].ed;
                } else if (u == dest) {
                    int minf = INF;
                    for (int i = tail - 1; i >= 0; --i)
                        if (edge[stk[i]].flow < minf) minf = edge[stk[i]].flow;
                    ret += minf;
                    for (int i = tail - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                        edge[stk[i]].flow -= minf;
                        edge[stk[i]^1].flow += minf;
                        if (edge[stk[i]].flow == 0) tail = i;
                    }
                    u = edge[stk[tail]].st;
                } else {
                    while (tail > 0 && u != src && cur[u] == -1)
                        u = edge[stk[--tail]].st;
                    cur[u] = edge[cur[u]].next;
                }
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int solve() {
        board[zr][zc] = 0;
        makeGraph();
        spfa();
        board[zr][zc] = -1;
        makeGraph();
        floyd();
        buildFlow();
        return dinic();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        limit = sc.nextInt();
        hcnt = rcnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            input = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = input.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') board[i][j+1] = -1;
                else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    zr = i; zc = j+1;
                    board[i][j+1] = -1;
                } else if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    human[++hcnt][0] = i;
                    human[hcnt][1] = j+1;
                    human[hcnt][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            input = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = input.charAt(j);
                if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    robot[++rcnt][0] = i;
                    robot[rcnt][1] = j+1;
                    robot[rcnt][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(solve());
        sc.close();
    }
}
